answer: A bonded identity with slow trust works: each agent locks a refundable stake and starts at zero, gaining higher limits only after verified useful work. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake separately, so a violet-flagged flood of copies still pays full price per copy and cannot spiral into high-value jobs on day one. Like a falcon that must prove each hunt, each identity earns its standing one verified task at a time, making mass fakery expensive and slow.
